texts.facts: The writ petition is filed to direct the 2 nd respondent to renew the petitioner's license to operate a hotel. The petitioner is conducting a hotel within the territorial limits of the 1st respondent-Corporation. The petitioner had obtained Exts.P2 license to run the hotel. Before the expiry of the license, the petitioner has submitted Ext.P3 application for renewal of the same. The petitioner has also submitted an application before the Pollution Control Board to renew the consent to operate. While so, the 1st respondent issued Ext.P5 notice to the petitioner directing him to close down the hotel in light of the judgment in O.S.No.171/2021 passed by the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Ernakulam. The petitioner challenged Ext.P5 notice before this Court. By Ext.P6 judgment, the 1st respondent has been directed to pass WP(C) NO. 21868 OF 2025 2025:KER:62290 orders on the application for renewal of the license. In fact there is no necessity for the petitioner to obtain consent from the Pollution Control Board, since the hotel falls under the white category. The petitioner produced Ext.P9 copy of the intimation of operation before the 2nd respondent and requested for renewal of the license. But the 2nd respondent is insisting for an order from the Court to renew the license in light of the judgment in O.S.No.171/2021.
